info.name: Inventory & Warehouse Management - Integration
info.description: PDF-aligned API integration suite. Before running, start the backend with MONGODB_URI set to a dedicated replica-set database whose name ends in _test, and manually verify the active backend configuration: Postman cannot inspect the server's MongoDB URI. Set testDatabaseConfirmed=true only after verification. The pre-request guard blocks non-local backend URLs and unconfirmed/non-test database names, but is not proof of the server's database target. Never point this suite at production. Login uses the HttpOnly cookie jar. Product/profile/logo image tests require a test ImageKit account and a local image file selected with imagePath.

exec: const baseUrl = pm.environment.get('baseUrl') || '';
const databaseName = pm.environment.get('testDatabaseName') || '';
if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:\d+)?$/.test(baseUrl)) { throw new Error('Safety stop: baseUrl must be a local backend URL.'); }
if (pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'true' || !/_test$/i.test(databaseName)) { throw new Error('Safety stop: confirm a dedicated MongoDB test database ending in _test first.'); }
pm.collectionVariables.set('runId', Date.now().toString());
pm.test('logout succeeds and clears the old session', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: 08 - Order processing, rollback and duplicate prevention
Login as warehouse manager for order fulfillment

item.name: Reduce product B stock to force a mid-order failure

exec: pm.test('both balances remain unchanged after rollback', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const rows = pm.response.json().stock; const a = rows.find(function (row) { return (row.product._id || row.product) === pm.collectionVariables.get('productAId'); }); const b = rows.find(function (row) { return (row.product._id || row.product) === pm.collectionVariables.get('productBId'); }); pm.expect(a.quantity).to.eql(4); pm.expect(b.quantity).to.eql(1); });
